trust_decision.summary: Whether an authenticated user's terminal command string is limited to the TERMINAL_COMMANDS allowlist (binary and safe arguments) before it reaches a shell; decided inline in the 'terminal' action of pheditor.php by a metacharacter blacklist plus a string-prefix allowlist match, then passed raw to shell_exec.

landing_point.why: The only shell_exec in the project, in the 'terminal' POST action; the advisory names the terminal allowlist and the metacharacter sanitisation directly above it (pheditor.php:588-605).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST action=terminal; new per-binary dangerous-argument list plus terminal_extra_checks (fix.diff:165-187)
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler + new helper function in same file

fix_sites.entry_point: POST action=terminal; sink changed from shell_exec string to proc_open argv array with tokenize helper (fix.diff:143-163)
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler sink + new helper in same file

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changes are in the single 'terminal' case of pheditor.php and two new helper functions in the same file; no second implementation, wrapper or lower-level API exists (only one shell sink: pheditor.php:617).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For allowlisted binaries not named in the report (e.g. zip, pheditor.php:25), a solver could argue the advisory's examples (find/git/php/tar) define the dangerous set and other allowlisted tools are 'the admin's configured choice'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate allowlisted commands with flags and quoted arguments (ls -la, git status/log, find . -name x, chmod 644 f, tar -xf) and the cd/dir tracking via the trailing 'pwd' echo that the client uses to update terminal_dir; an over-broad fix (reject all '-' args, or case-insensitive '-c' prefix matching that also rejects git -C) breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: shell metacharacters (& ; | $ ` CR LF) already blocked at pinned commit, replaced by a character whitelist (fix.diff:145)
allowlist prefix match (binary name as prefix of a longer token) replaced by exact first-token match (fix.diff:40-54)
dangerous option as separate token (e.g. -exec) and attached form (option prefix via stripos === 0, case-insensitive) (fix.diff:72-81)
quoted tokens (single and double) handled by tokenizer (fix.diff:149-160)
git transport URL forms ext::/fd:: anywhere in a token (fix.diff:167-173)
chmod symbolic setuid and 4-digit numeric modes (fix.diff:175-184)

O7_producer.where: Command and dir come straight from $_POST at pheditor.php:585-586; TERMINAL_COMMANDS is a constant in the same file (pheditor.php:25).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: zip is in the allowlist but the published fix gives it no dangerous-argument entry; zip has an option that runs a user-supplied test command, so argument injection into the same sink survives the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Report examples name find/git/php/tar/composer; zip looks like a plain archiver.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same function; only the knowledge of zip's option set separates it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: find options that write files (e.g. -fls) are not in the published find deny list; writes rather than executes, into the same command sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: File write, not command execution; editor already writes files by design.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add another allowlisted tool with an exec-capable option (e.g. an rsync/ssh-style -e, or a pager/editor option) to TERMINAL_COMMANDS.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The allowlist is a free-form constant maintainers extend with convenience tools; the per-binary deny list is hand-maintained.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second exec path for a 'run'/'composer install' button that builds a shell string from POST fields with the old prefix check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Single-file tool that already accreted features inline in the action switch (pheditor.php:331-637).

O9_family: OS command / argument injection (CWE-78, CWE-88) behind an allowlist

O10_build.toolchain: php-cli/php-fpm (PHP 7.4+/8.x, random_bytes, proc_open), any web server or php -S; composer.json/package.json only for front-end assets
O10_build.project_tests: none; repo contains no test directory (only pheditor.php, README.md, composer.json, package.json)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add more characters to the metacharacter blacklist at pheditor.php:588 or wrap the whole command in escapeshellarg, leaving option-based argument injection in allowlisted binaries open.

out_of_scope_notes: Allowlisted 'php <file>' runs any PHP file, and the editor can write PHP files by design (pheditor.php:340-370); this is the tool's purpose, not this advisory.
The terminal 'dir' value is only checked for '../' (pheditor.php:321-329) and can be any absolute path.
